text: I'd like you to make a city-at-night montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. I've had this nighttime city feeling stuck in my head and would love to see it brought to life. Please show neon signs and a passing train, and somewhere in all of that, this should be 10 seconds long and widescreen, with wet street reflections as well. Cut between those city shots on the beat of the music. I'm excited to see how these pieces come together. There shouldn't be any talking, singing or added text.
